race.comment: SPEAK THE TRUTH (7) makes his first appearance since July's Inter Dominion series where his best result was a placing in the opening round of heats. Has a strong fresh record and was readied with two trials, winning the latest. If anywhere near his best he'll be tough top stop. WHOS DELIGHT NZ (6) did a good job to come from wide on the back row and finish fourth last start, beaten 6 metres at this circuit and distance. Capable of playing a major role. COSMIC FLYER (4) is worth plenty of thought backing up off a win from the second row on Saturday night, his second success from his last three attempts at this circuit and distance. HOT AND TREACHEROUS NZ (5) showed improvement to place on Saturday so could be working back into form.
